examples.text: tañ'c'āhaṃ abhinandāmi, mahesi dhammam'uttamaṃ, yaṃ viditvā sato caraṃ, tare loke visattikaṃ.

29303.commentary: (MNa) na kho, āvuso visākha, taññ'eva upādānan'ti… taṃ'y'eva upādānaṃ te pañc'upādānakkhandhā

examples.text: taññ'eva nu kho, ayye, upādānaṃ te pañc'upādānakkhandhā udāhu aññatra pañcah'upādānakkhandhehi upādānan'ti? na kho, āvuso visākha, taññ'eva upādānaṃ te pañc'upādānakkhandhā, n'āpi aññatra pañcahupādānakkhandhehi upādānaṃ.

29304.meaning1: in this regard; in this case

tena hi, gahapati, taññ'ev'ettha paṭipucchissāmi, yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi.

29305.meaning1: that truly; that most certainly; that indeed

examples.text: atha ca pana tvaṃ, moghapurisa, attanā duggahitena amhe c'eva abbhācikkhasi, attānañ'ca khanasi, bahuñ'ca apuññaṃ pasavasi. tañ'hi te, moghapurisa, bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā'ti.
yañ'hi kayirā tañ'hi vade, yaṃ na kayirā na taṃ vade, akarontaṃ bhāsamānaṃ, parijānanti paṇḍitā.

29306.meaning1: that truly for him; that indeed for him

29307.meaning2: declivity of a mountain; side of a hill; precipice

29334.meaning1: wearing away of craving; depletion of desire; extinction of longing
29334.commentary: (SNa) taṇhakkhaye vimuttan'ti taṇhakkhayasaṅkhāte nibbāne tadārammaṇāya vimuttiyā vimuttaṃ.

examples.text: ime kho, āvuso, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā bahulīkatā taṇhakkhayāya saṃvattantī'ti
ākiñcaññaṃ pekkhamāno satimā, n'atthī'ti nissāya tarassu oghaṃ, kāme pahāya virato kathāhi, taṇhakkhayaṃ nattam'ah'ābhipassa.

29335.meaningLit: discourse on the wearing away of craving

29336.meaningLit: discourse on the wearing away of craving

29337.meaning1: liberation by wearing away of craving; release through depletion of desire; freedom by extinction of longing
29337.commentary: (THa) taṇhakkhayavimuttiyo'ti yathā taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiyo satthārā tuyhaṃ desitā, tathā kiṃ jānāsī'ti pucchi. taṇhakkhayavimuttiyo'ti vā taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttisuttassa desanaṃ pucchati.

examples.text: yo vejayantapāsāde, sakkaṃ so paripucchati, api āvuso jānāsi, taṇhakkhayavimuttiyo, tassa sakko viyākāsi, pañhaṃ puṭṭho yathātathaṃ.

29338.meaning1: who is liberated by the wearing away of craving; who is released through the depletion of desire; who is freed by the extinction of longing
29338.commentary: (ITIa) tato eva taṇhakkhayasaṅkhāte nibbāne vimuttattā taṇhakkhayavimuttino arahato.

examples.text: sabbarāgavirattassa, taṇhakkhayavimuttino, esanā paṭinissaṭṭhā, diṭṭhiṭṭhānā samūhatā, esanānaṃ khayā bhikkhu, nirāso akathaṃkathīti.

29339.meaning1: habituated to the destruction of craving; established in desirelessness; firmly entrenched in the extinction of longing
29339.commentary: (THa) taṇhakkhay'ādhimuttassā'ti taṇhā khīyati etthā'ti taṇhakkhayo, nibbānaṃ, tasmiṃ adhimuttassa upādiṃ bhayato, anupādiñ'ca khemato dassanena nirodhe ninnapoṇapabbhārassa.

examples.text: taṇhakkhay'ādhimuttassa, asammohañ'ca cetaso, disvā āyatan'uppādaṃ, sammā cittaṃ vimuccati.

29340.meaning1: obsessed with craving; immersed in craving (for)

examples.text: passāmi loke pariphandamānaṃ, pajaṃ imaṃ taṇhagataṃ bhavesu, hīnā narā maccumukhe lapanti, avītataṇhāse bhav'ābhavesu.

29341.commentary: (NIDD2) taṇhacchidan'ti. taṇhā'ti rūpataṇhā… dhammataṇhā. sā taṇhā buddhassa bhagavato chinnā ucchinnā samucchinnā vūpasantā paṭippassaddhā abhabb'uppattikā ñāṇ'agginā daḍḍhā. tasmā buddho taṇhacchido.

examples.text: taṇhacchidassa buddhassa, vītadhūmassa anupalittassa, āhuneyyassa yakkhassa, uttamapuggalassa atulassa, mahato yas'aggapattassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmī'ti.

29342.meaning2: in the power of, assailed by, craving

29343.meaning1: uprooting desire; pulling out craving; removing thirst

(THa) samūlaṃ taṇham'abbuyhā'ti taṇhāya mūlaṃ nāma avijjā. tasmā sāvijjaṃ taṇhaṃ aggamaggena samugghāṭetvā'ti attho. (THIa) samūlaṃ taṇham'abbuyhā'ti sānusayaṃ, saha vā avijjāya taṇhaṃ uddharitvā. avijjāya hi paṭicchādit'ādīnave bhavattaye taṇhā uppajjati.

examples.text: nikkhipitvā garuṃ bhāraṃ, aññaṃ bhāraṃ anādiya, samūlaṃ taṇham'abbuyha, nicchāto parinibbuto'ti.
chetvā naddhiṃ varattañ'ca, icchā lobhañ'ca pāpakaṃ, samūlaṃ taṇham'abbuyha, evaṃ yātrā bhavissatī'ti.

atha kho taṇhā ca arati ca ragā ca māradhītaro yena māro pāpimā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu.
nandisaṃyojano loko, vitakkassa vicāraṇaṃ, taṇhāya vippahānena, nibbānaṃ iti vuccati.
evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, phasso kho, āvuso, eko anto, phassasamudayo dutiyo anto, phassanirodho majjhe, taṇhā sibbinī.

29348.meaning1: name of one of the three daughters of Death

29350.meaning1: class of craving; category of desire

29351.meaning1: classes of craving; categories of desire

29357.commentary: (DNa) tadapi tesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ ajānataṃ apassataṃ vedayitaṃ taṇhāgatānaṃ paritassita-vipphanditam'evā'ti yena diṭṭhi-assādena diṭṭhisukhena diṭṭhivedayitena te somanassajātā sassataṃ attānañ'ca lokañ'ca paññapenti catūhi vatthūhi, tadapi tesaṃ bhavantānaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ dhammānaṃ sabhāvaṃ ajānantānaṃ apassantānaṃ vedayitaṃ taṇhāgatānaṃ kevalaṃ taṇhāgatānaṃ'y'eva taṃ vedayitaṃ, tañ'ca kho pan'etaṃ paritassitavipphanditam'eva.

examples.text: tatra, bhikkhave, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā sassatavādā sassataṃ attānañ'ca lokañ'ca paññapenti catūhi vatthūhi, tadapi tesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ ajānataṃ apassataṃ vedayitaṃ taṇhāgatānaṃ paritassita-vipphanditam'eva.
ime ca, bhikkhave, cattāro āhārā kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? ime cattāro āhārā taṇhānidānā taṇhāsamudayā taṇhājātikā taṇhāpabhavā.

29362.meaning1: net of craving; snare of desire

29363.meaning1: enslaved by craving; a slave of desire

29365.meaning1: desire and view; craving and belief

29367.meaning1: with craving as companion; accompanied by desire
29367.commentary: (ANa) taṇhādutiyo'ti ayañ'hi satto anamatagge saṃsāravaṭṭe saṃsaranto na ekako'va saṃsarati, taṇhaṃ pana dutiyikaṃ labhanto'va saṃsarati. tena vuttaṃ, taṇhādutiyo'ti.

29368.meaning1: spoiled by craving; ruined by desire; corrupted by craving

examples.text: tiṇadosāni khettāni, taṇhādosā ayaṃ pajā. tasmā hi vītataṇhesu, dinnaṃ hoti mahapphalaṃ.

29369.meaning1: overpowered by craving; dominated by desire

examples.text: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, bhikkhave, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekacco moghapuriso avidvā avijjāgato taṇh'ādhipateyyena cetasā satthu sāsanaṃ atidhāvitabbaṃ maññeyya, iti kira, bho, rūpaṃ anattā, vedanā anattā, saññā anattā, saṅkhārā anattā, viññāṇaṃ anattā, anattakatāni kammāni kamattānaṃ phusissantī'ti.

29370.meaning1: slave to craving; overpowered by craving; victim of desire

examples.text: ye keci kāmesu asaññatā janā, avītarāgā idha kāmabhogino, punappunaṃ jātijar'ūpagāmi te, taṇh'ādhipannā anusotagāmino.
taṇh'ādhipanne manuje pekkhamāno, santāpajāte jarasā parete, tasmā tuvaṃ piṅgiya appamatto, jahassu taṇhaṃ apunabbhavāyā'ti.

29371.meaning2: destruction of craving; crushing of desire
29371.commentary: (NIDD2 2.8) taṇhānigghātanaṃ taṇhāpahānaṃ taṇhāvūpasamaṃ taṇhāpaṭinissaggaṃ taṇhāpaṭippassaddhiṃ amataṃ nibbānaṃ.

examples.text: tvañ'ca me dhammam'akkhāhi, taṇhānigghātanaṃ muni, yaṃ viditvā sato caraṃ, tare loke visattikaṃ.
ime ca, bhikkhave, cattāro upādānā. kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? ime cattāro upādānā taṇhānidānā taṇhāsamudayā taṇhājātikā taṇhāpabhavā.

29373.meaning1: ending of craving; cessation of desire

examples.text: channaṃ tv'eva, phagguna, phass'āyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā phassanirodho, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho, vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho
kathaṃ pan'āvuso, āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti na hotī'ti? avijjāvirāgā kho, āvuso, vijj'uppādā taṇhānirodhā, evaṃ āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti na hotī'ti.

29374.meaning1: leading to the ending of craving; leading to the cessation of desire

examples.text: yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako taṇhañ'ca pajānāti, taṇhāsamudayañ'ca pajānāti, taṇhānirodhañ'ca pajānāti, taṇhānirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañ'ca pajānāti, ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti

29375.meaningLit: discourse on the ending of craving

29376.meaning1: underlying tendency towards craving; dormant desire

examples.text: yathā'pi mūle anupaddave daḷhe, chinno'pi rukkho punareva rūhati, evam'pi taṇh'ānusaye anūhate, nibbattatī dukkham'idaṃ punappunaṃ.

29378.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of taṇhāpaccaya
29378.meaning1: dependent on craving; due to desire
29378.commentary: (SNPa) taṇhāpaccayā'ti kammasambhārataṇhāpaccayā. (NIDD1a) taṇhāpaccayā upādānan'ti cattāri upādānāni kām'upādānaṃ diṭṭh'upādānaṃ sīlabbat'upādānaṃ attavād'upādānaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ maṃ avadantaṃ yo evaṃ puccheyya, kiṃpaccayā nu kho, bhante, taṇhā'ti, esa kallo pañho. tatra kallaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ
vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ

29379.meaningLit: discourse on the question about craving

29380.meaning1: produced by craving; generated by desire

examples.text: ime ca, bhikkhave, cattāro āhārā kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? ime cattāro āhārā taṇhānidānā taṇhāsamudayā taṇhājātikā taṇhāpabhavā.

29382.meaning1: exhausted craving for becoming; consumed craving for existence; (comm) exhausted craving and becoming

examples.text: yo'dhataṇhaṃ pahantvāna, anāgāro paribbaje, taṇhābhavaparikkhīṇaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

29383.commentary: (VISMa) taṇhāya samādhissa ujupaṭipakkhattā sā samathapaṭipadāya paripanthinī'ti āha taṇh'ābhibhūtassa hi dukkhā paṭipadā hotī'ti.

29384.meaning1: craving, comparing and belief; desire, conceit and view
29384.compound: dvanda (taṇhā ca māna ca diṭṭhi ca)

examples.text: eso me attā'ti diṭṭhiggāho. evaṃ rūp'ārammaṇā taṇhā-māna-diṭṭhiyo kathitā honti. rūpaṃ pana attā'ti na vattabbaṃ.

29385.meaning1: due to craving, conceit and belief

29386.meaning1: rooted in craving; stemming from desire

examples.text: nava taṇhāmūlakā dhammā, taṇhaṃ paṭicca pariyesanā, pariyesanaṃ paṭicca lābho, lābhaṃ paṭicca vinicchayo, vinicchayaṃ paṭicca chandarāgo, chandarāgaṃ paṭicca ajjhosānaṃ, ajjhosānaṃ paṭicca pariggaho, pariggahaṃ paṭicca macchariyaṃ, macchariyaṃ paṭicca ārakkho

29388.meaning2: (denominative from taṇhā) thirsts, has a craving
29388.commentary: (SNt) na taṇhāyati na bhāyati taṇhāvuttino abhāvā, tato eva bhayavatthuno ca abhāvā.

examples.text: anupādiyaṃ na paritassatī'ti anupādiyanto agaṇhanto n'eva taṇhāparitassanāya, na bhayaparitassanāya paritassati, na taṇhāyati na bhāyatī'ti attho.

29389.meaning1: taking pleasure in craving; delighting in desire

examples.text: taṇh'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, taṇhāratassa taṇhāsammuditassa, taṇhānirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti … n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti.

29390.meaning1: enjoying craving; taking pleasure in desire

examples.text: na taṇh'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, na taṇhāratassa na taṇhāsammuditassa, taṇhānirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa na hoti…pe. … n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa na hoti.

29391.meaning1: creeper of craving; tendrils of desire

examples.text: kadā nu'haṃ bhayajananiṃ dukh'āvahaṃ, taṇhālataṃ bahuvidh'ānuvattaniṃ, paññāmayaṃ tikhiṇam'asiṃ gahetvā, chetvā vase tam'pi kadā bhavissati.

29392.meaning2: coating of craving; smear of lust

29394.meaning1: extinction of craving; destruction of craving

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā aññāsikoṇḍañño bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ paccavekkhamāno.
kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti

29396.meaning1: freed by the exhaustion of craving; liberated through the dissolution of desire
29396.commentary: (ANa) taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hotī'ti taṇhāsaṅkhaye nibbāne taṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā vimuttacittatāya taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto nāma saṃkhittena kittāvatā hoti. yāya paṭipattiyā taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti, tam'eva khīṇ'āsavassa bhikkhuno pubbabhāgapaṭipadaṃ saṃkhittena desethā'ti pucchati.

examples.text: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti
vuttam'idaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā sakkapañhe, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttā, te accantaniṭṭhā accantayogakkhemino accantabrahmacārino accantapariyosānā seṭṭhā devamanussānan'ti.

29397.meaning1: liberation through the extinction of craving
29397.commentary: (MNa) imaṃ kho me tumhe, bhikkhave, saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ dhārethā'ti, bhikkhave, imaṃ saṃkhittena desitaṃ mayhaṃ, taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttidesanaṃ tumhe niccakālaṃ dhāreyyātha mā pamajjeyyātha. desanā hi ettha vimuttipaṭilābhahetuto vimuttī'ti vuttā.

examples.text: yathā kathaṃ pana kho, kosiya, bhagavā saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ abhāsi? sādhu mayam'pi etissā kathāya bhāgino assāma savanāyā'ti.
imaṃ kho me tumhe, bhikkhave, saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ dhāretha, sātiṃ pana bhikkhuṃ kevaṭṭaputtaṃ mahātaṇhājāla-taṇhāsaṅghāṭa-ppaṭimukkan'ti.
n'atthi rāgasamo aggi, n'atthi dosasamo gaho, n'atthi mohasamaṃ jālaṃ, n'atthi taṇhāsamā nadī.

29399.meaning1: source of craving; arising of desire
29399.commentary: (MNa) taṇhāsamudayā āhārasamudayo'ti purimataṇhāsamudayā paṭisandhikānaṃ āhārānaṃ samudayo nibbatto hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: taṇhāsamudayā āhārasamudayo, taṇhānirodhā āhāranirodho, ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo āhāranirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto, sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
